scope: Static triage-record validation; no production claim or runtime validation.
checks: Original inventory bytes and SHA-256 match frozen revision.
All B1 IDs, A1 primary IDs and secondary roles, and exclusions accounted for.
Exactly one disposition per decision unit; reason, origin, repair and RCA references resolve.
All quoted source ranges and original trigger quotations match their pinned revisions.
Every proposed manifest before-value matches the frozen worker graph.
All tracked changes confined to plan Status; register and underlying account/machinery unchanged.
Only the new record directory contains untracked files.
Relative Markdown links resolve; record links originate only in the associated plan.
No trailing whitespace in record Markdown; git diff --check passes.
